schema_note: dr_details live primarily on each paper in papers-data.json. This mirror is bibcode -> entries for inspection/tools. Top-level metrics.dynamic_range binary flags are unchanged.

2008A&A...487..419B.title: Correcting direction-dependent gains in the deconvolution of radio interferometric images

dr_details.scope: Full-beam imaging DR ceilings from DD effects / pointing

execution_context.definition_used: Imaging dynamic-range limit from direction-dependent and pointing systematics

dr_details.evidence: First-/second-order polarization leakage (~1e-2 / ~1e-4) motivates full-Mueller treatment above DR of a few thousand; DD effects and pixelized sky models limit full-beam DR to ~1e4–1e5; conclusion quotes ~1e5:1 pointing-error limit. No tabulated achieved reconstruction DR.

2008ISTSP...2..647C.title: The Noncoplanar Baselines Effect in Radio Interferometry: The W-Projection Algorithm

execution_context.definition_used: DR1 = peak brightness / median absolute deviation from image median

dr_details.evidence: Reports DR1 across methods: 2D FFT 1,570; 9×9 facets 12,580; w-projection 64 planes 18,198; 256 planes 50,888.

execution_context.definition_used: DR2 = peak / |strongest nearby negative feature| around a bright source

dr_details.evidence: DR2 rises from 2.8 (2D FFT) and 40 (facets) to 524 (64 planes) and 984 (256 planes).

dr_details.scope: W-projection vs uvw-space faceting at comparable DR

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Same controlled benchmark as DR1/DR2 table

dr_details.evidence: Authors report about a factor of 3 in error performance over facets in favor of w-projection, alongside order-of-magnitude residual-time advantages at comparable dynamic range.

2008ISTSP...2..793C.title: Multiscale CLEAN Deconvolution of Radio Synthesis Images

execution_context.definition_used: Reconstructed-image peak / off-source RMS
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (M31/M51 models; VLA C array X-band)

dr_details.evidence: Source-size and noise sweeps report dynamic range as peak / off-source RMS; at low input SNR, reconstructed DR flattens near 4 as thermal noise dominates.

2011A&A...532A..71R.title: A multi-scale multi-frequency deconvolution algorithm for synthesis imaging in radio interferometry

execution_context.definition_used: Peak-to-peak-residual dynamic range

dr_details.evidence: Peak-to-peak-residual DR rose from 1,600 (ignore spectral structure) to 110,000 with four Taylor terms; noise-free Taylor-order tests also quote DR ≈100,000.

execution_context.definition_used: DR limit if primary-beam spectral variation ignored
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulated primary-beam effect across 2:1 EVLA band

dr_details.evidence: Simulated primary beam can impose a dynamic-range limit near 1,000 if ignored (apparent spectral index ≈ −1.4 at half-power).

2014MNRAS.444..606O.title: WSClean: an implementation of a fast, generic wide-field imager for radio astronomy

execution_context.definition_used: Operating/simulation dynamic range quoted as ~1:1000

dr_details.evidence: Conclusion reports no noticeable accuracy loss in simulations reaching about 1:1000 dynamic range (and in a real field with 10.3 Jy/beam peak vs 67 mJy/beam residual noise).

dr_details.scope: SSDGA / HMP vs uncorrected faceting imaging
dr_details.evidence: Authors state HMP or SSD increases dynamic range and reduces flux-density/spectral-index error; residual images improve after DD/wideband correction, but achieved DR is not tabulated.

2025arXiv251213591C.title: astroCAMP: A Community Benchmark and Co-Design Framework for Sustainable SKA-Scale Radio Imaging

execution_context.definition_used: DR = I_max / σ_res (peak over residual-image RMS)
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Framework definition; Section 6 runs do not tabulate achieved DR

dr_details.evidence: Defines DR = I_max / σ_res as a core quality metric for faint-emission detectability. Named in the algorithmic-quality set with dirty RMS and PSNR/SSIM; not tabulated as a measured Section 6 result.

2022ApJ...939L...4D.title: First AI for Deep Super-resolution Wide-field Imaging in Radio Astronomy: Unveiling Structure in ESO 137-006

execution_context.definition_used: Nominal target DR from normalized dirty-image peak / estimated image-domain noise
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Real MeerKAT data (configuration estimate, not calibrated achieved DR)

dr_details.evidence: Dirty peaks 0.69/0.37 Jy imply nominal target DR ≈5×10⁵ and 2.2×10⁵; authors caution reconstructed peaks (~0.05 Jy) are >10× lower — regularization estimates, not measured fidelity.

2023MNRAS.522.5576W.title: Scalable precision wide-field imaging in radio interferometry: II. AIRI validated on ASKAP data

dr_details.unit: inverse target DR / denoiser noise levels
dr_details.scope: ASKAP AIRI denoiser selection (shelf vs universal)

execution_context.definition_used: Training noise σ interpreted as inverse target image dynamic range; dirty peak as sky-peak upper bound
execution_context.noise_estimator: Image-domain noise from visibility noise, spectral norm, weighting
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Real ASKAP (no calibrated DR benchmark reported)

dr_details.evidence: Denoiser noise levels (2e-5, 4e-5, 8e-5) are inverse target DR; dirty-image peak used to rescale when true sky peak is unavailable. Paper explicitly does not report a calibrated achieved DR score.

2024ApJS..273....3A.title: The R2D2 Deep Neural Network Series Paradigm for Fast Precision Imaging in Radio Astronomy

dr_details.scope: R2D2 VLA simulation training and generic tests

execution_context.definition_used: Ground-truth dynamic range randomized for synthetic problems; also parameterizes log S/N transform

dr_details.evidence: Ground-truth DR randomized from 1e3 to 5e5; targeted experiments isolate low vs high DR (e.g. 5e3 vs 1e5) where residual ratios diverge. High-DR cases show residual structure around bright emission — DR is a configured test axis, not a tabulated achieved reconstruction DR.

2024A&A...690A.387R.title: fast-resolve: Fast Bayesian Radio Interferometric Imaging

dr_details.evidence: fast-resolve achieves higher dynamic range than classical resolve with improved low-surface-brightness detail; no explicit scalar DR formula tabulated.

dr_details.evidence: DR defined as max/faintest intensity (1/σ); test set spans DR 10–10⁴ to stress high-DR performance; logSNR uses a = image DR.

2025MNRAS.537.1608T.title: The AIRI plug-and-play algorithm for image reconstruction in radio-interferometry: variations and robustness

dr_details.scope: AIRI robustness simulations vs integration time

dr_details.evidence: Ground-truth images had DR slightly above 10⁴; simulated observations averaged 2.9×10³ (1 h) to 1.1×10⁴ (8 h). logSNR transform uses a = 2.5×10³ (lowest DR).

2025MNRAS.542..426T.title: S-R2D2: a spherical extension of the R2D2 deep neural network series paradigm for wide-field radio-interferometric imaging

execution_context.definition_used: Target dynamic range for simulated problems; also sets logSNR rlog parameter a

dr_details.evidence: Table 1 aggregates 60 test problems with DR ∈ [10³, 5×10⁵]; per-image examples span ≈8.9×10⁴–2.3×10⁵. DR is the configured test axis for SNR/logSNR/RDR comparisons.

2025MNRAS.543.1727L.title: MROP: modulated rank-one projections for compressive radio interferometric imaging

execution_context.definition_used: d = reciprocal of faintest ground-truth intensity
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (VLA/MeerKAT model coverage); real 3C 273 check without scalar DR

dr_details.evidence: Images span d ∈ [10³,10⁵], split into low [10³,10⁴] and high [10⁴,10⁵] for SNR/logSNR reporting. Real-data note recovers features across 4 orders of magnitude without a calibrated DR score.
